Mobility · Trust & Safety PRD

Uber — Safety Assurance Mode

Riders who feel unsafe even once are 3x more likely to churn within 30 days. This PRD defines a Silent SOS gesture, automatic live trip sharing, real-time route-deviation alerts, and late-night check-ins — scoped against retention and response-time targets.

Fintech · Checkout PRD

Razorpay One-Click

Magic Checkout's pre-fill only works where merchants integrate it — leaving shopper data unused everywhere else on Razorpay's network. One-Click proposes an OTP-gated identity layer that extends pre-fill to every gateway merchant with zero integration lift.

About

From enterprise systems to shippable product.

With two years as an engineer at Accenture working across SAP FI/FSCM modules, I bring a strong technical foundation to product management — understanding system constraints and enterprise workflows firsthand.

Through PM internships at Kotak Mahindra Bank and Wyreflow Technologies, I've owned end-to-end product work — from writing PRDs and running competitor analysis to driving real adoption metrics, including increasing active usage of a lending platform from 40% to 50%.

I combine this hands-on experience with structured problem-solving training from BCG, McKinsey, and Six Sigma, and an ongoing MBA at SDA Bocconi — giving me both the technical fluency and business rigor to translate user needs into shippable products.
